openings.claim: Stable identities plus weekly discrepancy reconciliation, provenance and unresolved decisions may improve coverage and recognition.
openings.discriminator: Excluded rows versus renamed-but-present courses; identity alone cannot decide split membership.
openings.fit: Conditional on private processing, supported CSV, concurrent attendance, six days and existing hosting.
openings.probe: Counterbalance incumbent, identity-only, reconciliation-only and combined fabricated tasks: stable, reassigned, renamed, split, stale/shared omissions. Independently specify truth; measure coverage, effort, unresolved outcomes; test isolation/concurrency.
openings.uncertainty: Identifiers/history unverified; never infer missing history. Shared omissions evade agreement; reconciliation costs effort; association is not causation.

openings.claim: Locate active effort in reconciliation versus download/import.
openings.discriminator: Transition-specific checking versus similar import effort across conditions.
openings.fit: Share six coordinators' two-session budget across probes.
openings.probe: Record intended sets first; separately time checking, correction, requests, download, import and replacement waiting.
openings.uncertainty: Reference completeness/timing and spreadsheet behavior unknown; fabricated tasks limit transfer.

openings.claim: Private completion-triggered receipts may shorten replacement waiting.
openings.discriminator: Requires handoff-caused delay; completion does not establish correctness.
openings.fit: Verify authorization, bounded retries, concurrency and shared limits.
openings.probe: Check exact authorized center/week request-to-CSV binding and completion hooks; measure waiting separately.
openings.uncertainty: Dependencies unverified; active effort/accuracy may remain unchanged.

decision: Diagnose and check feasibility first; no proven remedy. Count unresolved exports. Subsequently assess 40 exports: median handling <=12 minutes, intended sets >=95%, zero cross-center rows. Existing sample excludes split-center evidence.
